mapping: The exact retained USFM archive defines member and line order. Every source line is represented by a source-pointed TEI carrier and has its exact source line in a child source-usfm-raw note. Chapters, verses, heads, speakers, poetry, paragraphs, inline words, notes, cross-references, front matter, and glossary are kept as separate source-native structures. No source text or whitespace is changed. The retained USFX archive is independently traversed by book/chapter/verse milestones to corroborate the verse text; non-verse description headings and speaker labels are compared as structures rather than folded into verse wording.
